items.q: Where will post-AI wealth go, according to Po-Shen Loh?
items.a: Not through **exam rankings** or stable credential paths — through **thoughtful-network economic flow**: high-trust networks of caring, flexible people connected across geographies who route resources **person-to-person**, not via bureaucratic aid.

items.q: Why are talented rural and African kids invisible to the global economy?
items.a: Outsiders **don't know them**, not because they lack talent. Many have **no phones/internet** yet "figure out how to make their own games" — **digital absence** can produce **authentic curiosity** and non-standard problem solving that standard curricula hide.

items.q: How does Expii's coaching model create economic opportunity?
items.a: Pairs high-school coaches (selected for **caring + on-the-spot thinking**) with middle-schoolers worldwide. Cross-border friendships (US/Korea/China ↔ Rwanda/Ethiopia) seed **high-trust remote-work arbitrage**: hire people you know, split wage differentials, **both sides win**.

items.q: Is blue-collar work safe from AI?
items.a: No. **Hyundai + Boston Dynamics** humanoids signal manufacturing robot workers soon. Whatever skills humans have, AI will surpass them — including physical work.

items.q: What durable human traits survive automation?
items.a: **Care that humanity exists** (readable in eyes — never in robot eyes), flexibility, great intention, learning capacity, and people who **can't be bought off**. Interconnected EVs ("**computers with four wheels**") show why: one hacked update could weaponize a fleet — acute shortage of **trustworthy guardians**.

items.q: How do AI exam-ranking apps create "human robots"?
items.a: China's AI exam apps make people into **performance improvers for standard tests** while AI (Claude Opus 4.5) already solves contest math. A **20-year grind** can end in **no job** — a major mental-health crisis.

items.q: What practical skills help you break out?
items.a: **Fluent English**, demonstrate **genuine care**, and solve **never-seen-before problems**. Motivate via **thoughtful-people networks** (thinkers enjoy thinkers → natural entrepreneurship). *"For everyone who wanted a **stable life** — good luck, AI is going to take that."*
